authorInstruction.title: GeoCeDG — PRE-G9B-R6-plus-F4-A-SCOPE-AMENDMENT-01
authorInstruction.option: A of the focus gate stop report

amendment.popup: light-weight popup without the FlatLaf drop shadow, scoped to the GeoCeDG line-style popup holding the field; global Swing popup settings untouched
amendment.layout: line-type table above; slider and numeric editor on one row, editor immediately right of the slider, vertically aligned, compact, sized from font metrics and insets; GeoCeDG-owned horizontal container; no duplicated state
amendment.heavyWeightCase: the field must not look editable while unable to take focus; restricted availability characterized for author disposition before acceptance

notAuthorized: changes to PopupMenuButtonD, EuclidianStyleBarD, GuiManager3D or other inherited frontend classes

gate.required: complete real-window gate (15 items) plus 3D compatibility and window-bound positions, Temurin 25.0.4, isolated settings, java.awt.Robot
gate.inputSafety: no editing or destructive key unless the field is the confirmed focus owner
